r_min_rule: the SHORTEST cross-unit distance of each class among the 48 FIT geometries — the arms runner's own boundedness check uses these three with kT = 9.28e-4

d0.declared: BEFORE the wall fit (§2 D0): the exponent's drift measured across the two families, and the tolerance rule that follows from it

boundedness_only_set.rule: R_OO ≤ 2.3 Å — the 12 tilt readings at 2.1 and 2.3 Å AND the 6 twist readings at 2.3 Å; these enter G-B0 only and are never fit

single_class.rule: E_exch = A·e^(−b·R_OO), b the negated OLS slope of ln E_exch on R_OO in bohr, fit per family per tilt on the FIT set alone

three_class.rule: FIELD-7's three-class wall fit on each family's FIT readings alone; the per-class exponents and their relative spread between the two families

d0.delta_rule: the LARGER of the single-class spread over the 12 and the largest per-class spread across the two families

s1.tolerance_rule: max(δ/2·E_exch, 1e-4) with δ/2 = 0.129608936, DERIVED in D0 and not typed

wall_fit.reading_set: the 48 at R_OO ≥ 2.5 Å; the 18 at R_OO ≤ 2.3 Å are NOT fit and enter G-B0 only
wall_fit.nonnegativity: a class whose fitted amplitude is negative is dropped (amplitude an exact 0.0) and the rest refit; the most negative first, one class per round

plant_ii.plant: the SAME 48-reading fit judged at FIELD-8's typed twentieth instead of the derived rule
plant_ii.typed_rule: 0.05·E_exch (§5 (ii)'s own rule, a pure fraction with no absolute floor)
plant_ii.carrier_definition: δ/2, the derived tolerance fraction itself — the sector the plant acts on is the tolerance

g_b0.bounded: H–O potential falls to -4.2908e-2 at r = 2.68 bohr, more than kT below its value -4.1621e-2 at its fit floor r_min = 2.781
g_b0.rule: SeamModel::bounded walks each cross-unit class potential from its own r_min inward to 0.5 bohr on a 0.05 grid and names the first value more than kT below the value at r_min, or a value at 0.5 bohr that is not positive; none means the arms may run, a name means the arms are VOID before they run
g_b0.verdict: a fall named — the arms are VOID (§2 G-B0)
g_b0.hole_reading: H–O potential falls inward at r = 2.95 bohr (-3.9317e-2 < -3.8632e-2)

c1.line_rule: the linear nodes at 2.7, 2.9 and 3.1 Å — where the bond lives — must ALL be within

contact_fit.nonnegativity: drop-and-refit, the most negative amplitude first
contact_fit.points_rule: the TWELVE exact geometries the engine serves with two units; the 2.1 Å node is outside the closure identity and is NOT a fit point
contact_fit.remainder: ΔE_exact − [E_q(g) − E_q(40)]_engine − wall(g), the NEW wall HELD at this harvest

dispersion.nodes: the 4 outer linear nodes (R_OO ≥ 2.9 Å), after both contact terms

g_c1.reference: E_q(g) − E_q(40 bohr), the engine's own field on both sides

readings_provenance.note: no exchange reading is taken by this runner; every one is a record, its geometry rebuilt here and matched to the record's own centers within 1e-9 bohr (M-STALE-INSTRUMENT)

referee: heitler_london_undeformed — the antisymmetrised product of the monomers' own wavefunctions, the monomers NOT deformed
